import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(inp):

    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; objs=[]
    for r in range(H):

                st=[(r,c)];seen[r][c]=True;comp=[]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop();comp.append((x,y,inp[x][y]))
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        for dy in(-1,0,1):
                            rr,cc=x+dx,y+dy
                            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and not seen[rr][cc] and inp[rr][cc]!=bg:

                objs.append(comp)
    multi=[o for o in objs if len(o)>1]
    markers=[o[0] for o in objs if len(o)==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for m in markers:

        origin=min(o,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
        # rel of special (a cell with color mv) to origin

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def comps8(g,bg):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<len(g)) or not(0<=b<len(g[0])) or g[a][b]==bg: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in (-1,0,1):
                        for db in (-1,0,1): st.append((a+da,b+db))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

def analyze(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps8(gi,bg)
    big=max(cs,key=len)
    # diff cells
    diff=[(r,c,gi[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    print('demo',i,'bg',bg,'bigcomp size',len(big),'colors',dict(Counter(gi[r][c] for r,c in big)))
    return big,diff,cs

for i in (5,6,7,8):
    big,diff,cs=analyze(i)
    # assign each diff cell to nearest bigcomp cell via anchor guess: print diff minus translation candidates
    # test: is each diff cell = some template cell under a symmetry of the template, anchored at a marker?
    import itertools
    ts=set(big)
    hmax=max(r for r,c in ts); wmax=max(c for r,c in ts)
    sym_funcs=[lambda r,c:(r,c), lambda r,c:(r,wmax-c), lambda r,c:(hmax-r,c), lambda r,c:(hmax-r,wmax-c),
               lambda r,c:(c,r), lambda r,c:(c,hmax-r), lambda r,c:(wmax-c,r), lambda r,c:(wmax-c,hmax-r)]
    marks=[c for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    print('  num single markers',len(marks))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def comps8(g,bg):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<len(g)) or not(0<=b<len(g[0])) or g[a][b]==bg: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in (-1,0,1):
                        for db in (-1,0,1): st.append((a+da,b+db))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

# Hypothesis: for each seed, decide transform based on anchor position in bbox.
# corner -> mirror; else translate. Test on all demos.
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps8(g,bg)
    seeds=[]
    for comp in cs:
        if len(comp)>1:
            cols=Counter(g[r][c] for r,c in comp)
            acell=[(r,c) for r,c in comp if g[r][c]==min(cols,key=lambda v:cols[v])][0]
            pts=[(r-acell[0],c-acell[1],g[r][c]) for r,c in comp if (r,c)!=acell]
            bry=(max(r for r,_ in [(p[0],p[1]) for p in pts])-min(r for _,r in [(p[1],p[0]) for p in pts])+1,0)
            br=min(p[0] for p in pts)-acell[0]; bh=max(p[0] for p in pts)-acell[0]+1
            bc=min(p[1] for p in pts)-acell[1]; bw=max(p[1] for p in pts)-acell[1]+1
            corners = (br==0 and (bw-1-bc)*0+ (bc==bw-1) ) or True
            # determine corner membership along each axis separately? Use full bbox
            rr=[p[0] for p in pts]; cc=[p[1] for p in pts]
            rlo,rhi=min(rr),max(rr); clo,chi=min(cc),max(cc)
            if (rlo==acell[0] or rhi==acell[0]) and (clo==acell[1] or chi==acell[1]): mono_anchor=True
            else: mono_anchor=False
            raw=pts; mir=[(dr,-dc,v) for dr,dc,v in pts]
            seeds.append({'raw':raw,'mir':mir,'mono_anchor':mono_anchor})
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    marks=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    for (mr,mc) in marks:
        v=g[mr][mc]
        hits=[s for s in seeds if any(p[2]==v for p in s['raw'])]
        if not hits: continue
        opts=[]
        for s in hits:
            for name,op_ in (('raw',s['raw']),('mir',s['mir'])):
                painted=0; bad=0
                for dr,dc,pv in op_:
                    rr,cc=mr+dr,mc+dc
                    if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
                        if g[rr][cc]==bg: painted+=1
                        elif g[rr][cc]!=pv and (rr,cc)!=(mr,mc): bad+=1
                opts.append((painted-bad*100,name,op_))
        opts.sort(key=lambda o:o[0], reverse=True)
        _,_,op_=opts[0]
        for dr,dc,pv in op_:
            rr,cc=mr+dr,mc+dc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==bg:
                out[rr][cc]=pv
    return out

res=[]
for i in (5,6,7,8):
    fo=f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']

def stamp_cells(i, mr, mc, seedidx, nme):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(gi,bg)
    seeds=[]; singles=[]
    for s in cs:
        if len(s)>1:
            rare=min(set(gi[a][b] for a,b in s),key=lambda v:sum(1 for a,b in s if gi[a][b]==v))
            anch=[(a,b) for a,b in s if gi[a][b]==rare][0]
            rel=[(a-anch[0],b-anch[1],gi[a][b]) for a,b in s]
            seeds.append((rare,rel))
        else: singles.append((s[0],gi[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]))
    rare,rel=seeds[seedidx]
    anchor=[(a,b) for a,b,p in rel if p==rare][0]
    body=[(a-anchor[0],b-anchor[1],pv) for a,b,pv in rel if pv!=rare]
    tf=TFS[nme]
    cells={(mr+tf((a,b))[0],mc+tf((a,b))[1]):pv for a,b,pv in body}
    return [(r,c,pv) for (r,c),pv in sorted(cells.items())]
# demo5 marker(7,11) color3, seed0: what transform gives diff {(7,12),(8,11),(8,12),(9,11)}?
for nme in ['id','h','v','r180','t','t2','t3','t4']:
    c=stamp_cells(5,7,11,0,nme)
    d=[p for p in c if p[0]>6 or p[1]>10]
    print(nme,sorted(c),'expected',(7,11),'diffmatch' if sorted(d)==[(7,12),(8,11),(8,12),(9,11)] and all(p[2]==5 for p in d) else '')

def solve(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps8(gi,bg)
    seeds=[]; markers=[]
    for s in cs:
        if len(s)>1:
            rare=min(set(gi[a][b] for a,b in s),key=lambda v:sum(1 for a,b in s if gi[a][b]==v))
            anch=[(a,b) for a,b in s if gi[a][b]==rare][0]
            rel=[(a-anch[0],b-anch[1],gi[a][b]) for a,b in s]
            seeds.append((rare,rel))
        else: markers.append((s[0][0],s[0][1],gi[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]))
    sols=[]
    def bt(k,used,path):
        if k==len(markers):
            if all(cells & cover == set() for cells,cover in zip([o[2] for o in path],[path[k-1][1:] if False else None]) ): return None
            return
        mr,mc,col=markers[k]
        opts=[]
        for si,(srare,srel) in enumerate(seeds):
            if srare!=col: continue
            anc=[(a,b) for a,b,p in srel if p==srare][0]
            body=[(a-anc[0],b-anc[1],p) for a,b,p in srel if p!=srare]
            for nme,tf in TFS.items():
                cells={(mr+tf((a,b))[0],mc+tf((a,b))[1]):p for a,b,p in body}
                ok=True
                for (r,c) in cells:
                    if (r,c)==(mr,mc): continue
                    if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): ok=False;break
                    if gi[r][c]!=bg: ok=False;break
                if not ok: continue
                # keep colors consistent with expected output (for checking)
                colok=all(go[r][c]==go[mr][mc] if False else True for r,c in [(r,c)] )
                opts.append((si,nme,frozenset(cells)))
        # choose option whose cells disjoint from already placed cells of SAME color... simpler: any overlap allowed if colors agree? try: no overlap at all
        for o in opts:
            cells={c for c,p in o[2].items()}
            if not cells & used:
                bt(k+1,used|cells,path+[o])
    bt(0,set(),[])
    print('demo',i,'nSol',len(sols))
    return sols,gi,go
